messages:
Jules: Heads-up — customer reported embeddings usage chart shows ~3x units vs billing. They sent screenshot: https://rbw.co/screenshot/abc123
Priya: Can you paste the account id + time range? Need to repro in analytics.
Jules: acct rwd-711, range 2026-03-01..2026-03-14. Customer says dashboard shows 'vectors' units but billing shows tokens. They think vectors double counted after batch change.
Omar: Noted. Quick check on events: looks like two different ingestion pipelines tag metrics: 'embeddings_unit_v1' and 'embeddings_batch_v1' — could be double-emit on new batch path.
Priya: sharing a quick query I ran: ```SELECT event_time, sum(units) FROM metrics.embeddings WHERE account='rwd-711' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-14' GROUP BY 1;``` Got totals matching customer dashboard.
Kei: Billing records (internal) show token units = 1,250,000 for same range — dashboard shows ~3.6M vectors. That's a big mismatch.
Jules: Customer on the line asking for repro steps and whether they'll be billed for the inflations.
Priya: Hypothesis: batching path emits per-vector counts at both batch and per-item granularity; aggregator joins batch_events to item_events and double-sums when batch_id=NULL. I'll try to reproduce with synthetic requests.
Omar: Repro steps I used: 1) send batched embed request with 10 inputs, 2) check `producer.metrics` topic for `embeddings.v1` events, 3) run aggregator `agg.daily_embedding_units` job locally. I saw 2 messages per request: one with `batch_size=10`, one with `per_item=1`.
Priya: If true, quick mitigation is to filter aggregator by `source='prometheus'` or dedupe by `event_uuid` before sum. I'll push a config change to staging.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: #INC-2026-92 — tag: analytics, billing, support.
Kei: For customer billing, we should not change historical invoices until root cause confirmed. Suggest offering credit while we investigate.
Jules: Customer accepted temporary credit offer. Please prioritise triage.
Omar: attaching sample event payload I captured:
```json
{"event_uuid":"e3f2-111","account":"rwd-711","batch_id":null,"units":10,"metric":"embeddings_unit_v1"}
{"event_uuid":"e3f2-111","account":"rwd-711","batch_id":"b-99","units":10,"metric":"embeddings_batch_v1"}
```
You can see same UUID reused due to producer bug.
Priya: Root cause: producer side started populating `event_uuid` before enrichment, and enrichment service re-emitted with same id plus batch_id. Aggregator was only grouping by `event_uuid` sometimes — when batch_id present, join produced duplicated rows. Fix: aggregator dedupe by `event_uuid` AND coalesce(batch_id,'') and add unit test.
Omar: I'll open PR to aggregator (analytics/agg-service#457) and add backfill script to compute deduped totals for last 60 days. Plan: run backfill in dry-run, produce corrected chart data, then apply.
Kei: How long for backfill? Customer asking for ETA.
Priya: Backfill dry-run estimated 3 hours for 60 days on staging data; production will be longer ~10h. We can run for their account first (fast).
Jules: Great. Keep me posted. Customer expects update in 24h.
Priya: PR opened, deploying to staging now. Will post staging dashboard link when ready.
Omar: After dedupe fix, sample totals align with billing for my test account. I'll hand off to Kei for bill reconciliation.
Kei: Acknowledged. I'll prepare provisional credit policy and flag finance for review.
Jules: Thanks team. Follow-up: once fix merged, we'll notify customer and close INC-2026-92.
